title: agents.yaml cli.probe block
description: Merged into AGENTS_SCHEMA under agents.*.cli.properties.probe (agent-identity: Declarative CLI Probe Block). Every argv list the probe executes (version_args, each help_args value, auth_status_args) is checked against the same denied-token pattern. Rules not expressible here (last token of auth_status_args is not 'login'; each help_args value contains a help token) are enforced in agents_config.validate.

help_args.description: Mode name -> help argv. Additionally each list must contain one of --help, -h, help (enforced in agents_config.validate).

auth_status_args.description: Additionally: the last token must not be "login" (enforced in agents_config.validate; not expressible here).
